verdict.rationale: Convertio offers a developer API with keys, a CLI and official wrappers, so a versioning and deprecation question is fair to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence mentions API version numbers, version pinning, changelogs or a deprecation policy. Probes for an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt both returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
